title: Sensible handoff templates and local probe queue
author: Asha Menon
release_notes: Adds an ephemeral local probe queue sidecar and a context-aware runbook template composer. Improves handoff quality by prefetching minimal telemetry and supplying responder suggestions. No infra changes required for hosted deployments; Private deployments can opt-in via config.
description: Context and motivation: Oncall handoffs frequently lack the minimal telemetry snapshot responders need to triage quickly (recent errors, recent deploys touched, top-5 traces). This PR introduces two cooperating features: a lightweight local probe-queue sidecar that prefetches a bounded set of telemetry artifacts during an incident, and a Sensible Runbook Composer (SRC) that instantiates short, contextual handoff templates based on severity, affected services, and prefetch results. Goals: reduce first-response time, reduce noisy handoff messages, and provide safe auto-suggested responders. Non-goals: replace full incident capture/export systems or store long-lived PII-laden artifacts.
commit_summary: a1f3b9b: Add local_probe_queue service and in-memory bounded store
b2c7e4d: Implement probe fetchers (metrics, top traces, recent deploys) with size limits
c3d88f1: Add runbook_composer module and template rules engine
d4e12aa: Wire runbook composer into incident-bot /oncall/handoff endpoint
e5f7b33: Add unit and integration tests; add docs and quickstart for operators
f6a9d44: Add feature flag and opt-in config for private deployments
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: This is a great direction. Can you confirm limits for trace payloads? We should ensure we never fetch >1MB per probe. -- replied: limits enforced in fetchers with 512KB per trace, 3 traces max.
Priya Kapoor: Please add a note about PII sanitization and a test that asserts redaction for stack traces. -- replied: added redaction util and unit test (tests/unit/redaction_test.go).

Jorge Silva: How does this interact with Private installs (no outbound telemetry)? Suggest a graceful disabled mode. -- replied: feature flag added, sidecar becomes noop if outbound disabled; documented behavior in charts/incident-bot/values.yaml.
Liam O'Connor: CI flaked on e2e once; re-run fixed it and all green. Approving now.
Priya Kapoor: Approved after docs addition and one small naming nitfix (renamed Compose -> Composer).
Merge comment: Squash-merged by Asha Menon after approvals and green CI.
ci_summary: CI: unit tests (pass), lint (pass), integration e2e (flaky - failed once on timeout, re-run succeeded), security-scan (pass). A small e2e timeout fixed by increasing test harness timeout in scripts/ci/retry-e2e.sh.
safety_checks: Feature gated with incident.sidecar.enabled; config default=false for Private installer. Sidecar uses a bounded in-memory store, no disk persistence, and explicit PII redaction on traces/log snippets. Added a config 'max_probe_bytes' with sane defaults.
operational_playback: Operators can enable via helm values (charts/incident-bot/values.yaml) and validate with the provided smoke test (tests/integration/test_handoff_flow.go). Rollout recommendation: canary to 10% of oncall rotation for 48 hours, monitor handoff latency and duplicate-notes alerts.
examples_and_docs: Added quick-handoffs.md with example handoff payloads and a checklist for enabling in Private deployments. README.md updated with sidecar image and resource recommendations (cpu: 50m, memory: 64Mi).
notes_for_release: Not user-facing API change; incident /oncall/handoff returns an additional 'suggested_responders' field when enabled. Backwards compatible: field is omitted unless feature is on. No breaking change.
post_merge_tasks: (1) Schedule one-day canary rollout. (2) Add monitoring: histogram of handoff assembly time, counter for sanitized_fields, gauge for probe_queue_size. (3) Follow-up ENG-1305 to add RBAC check for who can trigger prefetch.
qa_matrix: Unit tests added for composer rules, fetcher size limits and redaction. Integration test simulates a 'sev2' event and asserts runbook templating and suggested_responders present. E2E retried once due to harness timeout, resolved by adding backoff.
ops_impact: Low. Sidecar light-weight memory only; default disabled for Private. Hosted customers: enable via console toggle in a later release. No migrations. Monitors recommended.
acknowledgements: Thanks to SRE rotation (Liam), Docs (Priya) and Security (Jorge) for quick reviews and clarifying redaction requirements.
